body:
Jabari (S010) claim for B-2026-08-20-12: stop a missing local embedder from
silently disabling memory.

Design (index-correct): the vector store keeps ONE embedding space at a time.
A per-call "Ollama-then-cloud" race would mix two incompatible vector spaces
in one vec0 index (different dims, or same-dim-but-different-model vectors
that aren't comparable) and silently corrupt recall. So:

1. backend/src/storage/vector.py — add a second embed backend that speaks the
   OpenAI-compatible contract (POST {base}/embeddings, body {model, input} ->
   {data[0].embedding}); the Ollama /api/embeddings path stays the default and
   first choice. Selection is by config. When a cloud fallback is configured
   and the primary (Ollama) is unreachable at bind time, the store binds to
   the cloud backend for its lifetime (one space, logged once) instead of
   returning None and disabling memory. The existing DIM / DIM-MISMATCH guard
   is reused so a backend whose dimension differs from the stored index is
   refused rather than blended in.
2. backend/src/core/config.py — new settings:
   LOCALMIND_EMBED_ADAPTER ("" = Ollama-only, today's behavior; "openai" =
   OpenAI-compatible cloud embedder, used as primary or as the failover
   target), LOCALMIND_EMBED_BASE_URL, LOCALMIND_EMBED_MODEL,
   LOCALMIND_EMBED_KEY_PROVIDER (reuses an already-stored provider key so no
   new secret surface is added), plus runtime-settings.json persistence in
   load_runtime_settings.
3. tests/core/test_vector_embed_fallback.py — new regression tests: Ollama
   reachable + no cloud config == today's behavior exactly (no cloud call);
   Ollama down + cloud configured == facts still store (the bug's fix);
   cloud backend selected consistently (never per-call mixed); dimension
   mismatch between backends refused, not blended; cache tiers keyed so a
   cloud vector never poisons an Ollama-keyed entry.

Default stays "" — zero behavior change for every existing Ollama user.

NOT claimed: loop.py (Baraka/S005), chat.py + agent_runtime.py (Imani/S008),
sessions.py + db.py + models.py + client.ts (Tega/S009). No edits to existing
comments in the two files I touch (vocab-sweep courtesy).

Live-verification per the standing bar on isolated port 8765 (never 8000).
Note: this machine has Ollama down and no cloud embedding key in
memory/secrets/, so the cloud leg may only be verifiable against a stub
OpenAI-compatible endpoint — I will report live-verified vs unit-tested
honestly rather than claim through the gap.
